prompt: Create a cinematic cyberpunk city rooftop at night in a rainstorm, wide 16:9 establishing shot from a low eye-level camera, with a wet reflective concrete surface dominating the foreground. The scene is a dense futuristic metropolis filled with tall dark skyscrapers, blue haze, mist, rain, and volumetric atmosphere. Use neon magenta and electric cyan lighting, physically based rendering, hyper-realistic 3D CGI, Octane-render quality, live-action sci-fi blockbuster aesthetic, high contrast, glossy reflections, puddles, subtle lens bloom, and moody depth of field. The rooftop contains exactly 6 prominent foreground/midground elements: 1 large black horizontal cylindrical tank on the left under pink strip lights, 1 chain-link fenced structure behind it with a glowing Japanese neon sign reading 未来はここにある, 1 small utility booth near center-left, 1 low metal railing and barrier line across the middle, 1 glowing magenta vending-machine-like light box on the right, and 1 bulky rooftop antenna or mechanical equipment tower on the far right with magenta highlights and dangling cables. In the background, include many high-rise towers but emphasize exactly 3 readable billboard areas: 1 enormous central vertical digital billboard showing a close-up face of a young woman with a short black bob haircut and pale skin, 1 adjacent vertical magenta sign with abstract glyph-like markings, and 1 smaller upper skyscraper sign reading BEATS. On the giant central billboard, include bold white text reading 04, Japanese text reading 未来, and a name below reading KIROSHI. Composition should have no people physically present on the rooftop, only the billboard face; keep the color palette deep navy, black, cyan, and hot pink; make the ground mirror the neon signage clearly; avoid daylight, warm sunlight, cartoon styling, or clean pristine surfaces.

promptZh: 创建一个雨夜中电影质感的赛博朋克城市天台，采用 16:9 宽画幅低机位定场镜头，前景为湿润且具有反射效果的混凝土表面。场景展现了一个密集的未来主义大都市，高耸的深色摩天大楼、蓝色雾霾、雨水和体积光氛围感十足。使用霓虹洋红色和电光青色照明，基于物理的渲染，超写实 3D CGI，Octane 渲染品质，真人科幻大片美学，高对比度，光泽反射，水洼，细腻的镜头光晕以及富有情绪的景深。天台包含 6 个显著的前景/中景元素：左侧粉色灯带下 1 个大型黑色水平圆柱形储罐，其后方 1 个带有发光日文霓虹灯招牌的铁丝网结构（招牌文字为 未来はここにある），中左侧 1 个小型公用设施亭，横跨中间的 1 条低矮金属栏杆和屏障线，右侧 1 个发光的洋红色自动售货机式灯箱，以及最右侧 1 个带有洋红色高光和悬垂电缆的笨重天台天线或机械设备塔。背景中包含许多高层建筑，但需强调 3 个清晰可见的广告牌区域：1 个巨大的中央垂直数字广告牌，显示着一位留着黑色短波波头、皮肤苍白的年轻女性特写面孔；1 个相邻的带有抽象符号标记的垂直洋红色招牌；以及 1 个较小的上方摩天大楼招牌（文字为 BEATS）。在巨大的中央广告牌上，包含醒目的白色文字 04，日文文字 未来，以及下方的名字 KIROSHI。构图中天台上不应有任何人物，仅保留广告牌上的面孔；配色方案保持深海军蓝、黑色、青色和亮粉色；确保地面清晰地映射出霓虹灯招牌；避免日光、暖色阳光、卡通风格或干净整洁的表面。
